q23110.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture the vehicles pass in this order: D, P, B, N.

explain.short: D has a free right and goes first. Then each one goes when its right is free: P, then B, then N.
explain.rule: No signs: give way to vehicles on your right. D's right is free, so D goes first; then P, then B, then N, one at a time.
explain.trap: 'nel seguente ordine' (in this order): check every letter - D, P, B, N is exactly right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: D, P, B, N

q23111.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicle N must pass last.

explain.short: N has B on its right, and B must wait for P, who waits for D. So N is the last one.
explain.rule: No signs: give way to vehicles on your right. D's right is free, so D goes first; then P, then B, then N, one at a time.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is right: N waits for all three others.

sceneParams.caption: N is last: D, P, B go before it

q23112.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicle B must pass after vehicle P.

explain.short: P is on B's right, so B gives way to P and passes after it.
explain.rule: No signs: give way to vehicles on your right. D's right is free, so D goes first; then P, then B, then N, one at a time.
explain.trap: 'dopo' (after) is right: P is on B's right.

sceneParams.caption: P is on B's right: B goes after P

q23113.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicle D passes before the other vehicles.

explain.short: D is the only vehicle with nobody on its right, so it goes first.
explain.rule: No signs: give way to vehicles on your right. D's right is free, so D goes first; then P, then B, then N, one at a time.
explain.trap: 'prima degli altri' (before the others) is right: D has a free right.

sceneParams.caption: D has a free right: D goes first

q23114.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicle B passes before vehicle N.

explain.short: B is on N's right, so N gives way to B: B passes first.
explain.rule: No signs: give way to vehicles on your right. D's right is free, so D goes first; then P, then B, then N, one at a time.
explain.trap: 'prima' (before) is right: B is on N's right.

sceneParams.caption: B is on N's right: B goes before N

q23115.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicle N passes after vehicle B.

explain.short: B comes from N's right, so N waits for B.
explain.rule: No signs: give way to vehicles on your right. D's right is free, so D goes first; then P, then B, then N, one at a time.
explain.trap: 'dopo' (after) is right: N is last of all.

sceneParams.caption: N goes after B (B is on its right)

q23116.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicle P may pass before vehicle B.

explain.short: P is on B's right, so P has priority over B and can pass first.
explain.rule: No signs: give way to vehicles on your right. D's right is free, so D goes first; then P, then B, then N, one at a time.
explain.trap: 'può passare prima' (may pass before) is right: B must wait for P.

sceneParams.caption: P is on B's right: P goes before B

q23117.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture the vehicles pass in this order: D, B, N, P.

explain.short: The right order is D, P, B, N. B cannot go before P, because P is on B's right.
explain.rule: No signs: give way to vehicles on your right. D's right is free, so D goes first; then P, then B, then N, one at a time.
explain.trap: 'nel seguente ordine' (in this order): D is right, but B before P is wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: P goes before B and N. Order: D, P, B, N

q23118.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture the vehicles pass in this order: P, B, N, D.

explain.short: The right order is D, P, B, N. P cannot go first: D is on its right.
explain.rule: No signs: give way to vehicles on your right. D's right is free, so D goes first; then P, then B, then N, one at a time.
explain.trap: 'nel seguente ordine' (in this order): D is first, not last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: D goes first. Order: D, P, B, N

q23119.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicles D and N pass at the same time.

explain.short: D goes first and N goes last: they do not pass together.
explain.rule: No signs: give way to vehicles on your right. D's right is free, so D goes first; then P, then B, then N, one at a time.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time) is wrong: D is first, N is last.

sceneParams.caption: Not together: D is first, N is last

q23120.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicles D and B pass at the same time.

explain.short: D goes first; B must still wait for P. So D and B do not pass together.
explain.rule: No signs: give way to vehicles on your right. D's right is free, so D goes first; then P, then B, then N, one at a time.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time) is wrong: P passes between D and B.

sceneParams.caption: Not together: D first, then P, then B

q23121.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicle P passes before vehicle B, but after vehicle N.

explain.short: P does pass before B, but N is the last of all, so P does not pass after N.
explain.rule: No signs: give way to vehicles on your right. D's right is free, so D goes first; then P, then B, then N, one at a time.
explain.trap: 'ma dopo quello N' (but after N) is the wrong part: N is last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: N is last. Order: D, P, B, N

q23122.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicles B and D pass first, either one of them.

explain.short: Only D goes first. B must wait for P, who is on its right.
explain.rule: No signs: give way to vehicles on your right. D's right is free, so D goes first; then P, then B, then N, one at a time.
explain.trap: 'indifferentemente' (either one, it does not matter) is wrong: only D is first.

sceneParams.caption: Only D goes first; B waits for P

keywords.en: either one / it does not matter

q23123.en: At the junction in the picture the vehicles pass in this order: D, C, A, H.

explain.short: D turns right without crossing anyone and goes first; then C, A and H follow the right-hand rule.
explain.rule: Each vehicle has another on its right. D turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody's path, so D goes first; then C, A, H.
explain.trap: 'nel seguente ordine' (in this order): D, C, A, H is exactly right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: D, C, A, H

q23124.en: At the junction in the picture vehicle A has its right occupied.

explain.short: C, coming from the top, is on A's right. So A's right is not free.
explain.rule: Each vehicle has another on its right. D turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody's path, so D goes first; then C, A, H.
explain.trap: 'la destra occupata' (right occupied) is right: C is on A's right.

sceneParams.caption: C is on A's right: A must wait

q23125.en: At the junction in the picture vehicle D has priority over vehicle C.

explain.short: D is on C's right, so C must give way to D.
explain.rule: Each vehicle has another on its right. D turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody's path, so D goes first; then C, A, H.
explain.trap: 'ha la precedenza' (has priority) is right: D is on C's right.

sceneParams.caption: D is on C's right: D goes first

q23126.en: At the junction in the picture vehicle D is the first to enter the junction.

explain.short: D only turns right, close to the corner, and crosses nobody's path, so it goes first.
explain.rule: Each vehicle has another on its right. D turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody's path, so D goes first; then C, A, H.
explain.trap: 'il primo' (the first) is right: D goes before everyone.

sceneParams.caption: D turns right and goes first

q23127.en: At the junction in the picture vehicle H is the last to cross the junction.

explain.short: H has A on its right, and A waits for C, who waits for D. So H is last.
explain.rule: Each vehicle has another on its right. D turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody's path, so D goes first; then C, A, H.
explain.trap: 'l'ultimo' (the last) is right: H waits for A.

sceneParams.caption: H is last: A is on its right

q23128.en: At the junction in the picture vehicle D must give way to vehicle C.

explain.short: It is the opposite: D is on C's right, so C gives way to D.
explain.rule: Each vehicle has another on its right. D turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody's path, so D goes first; then C, A, H.
explain.trap: 'deve dare la precedenza' (must give way) is the wrong way round: C gives way to D.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong way round: C gives way to D

q23129.en: At the junction in the picture vehicle C crosses first.

explain.short: C has D on its right, so C must wait for D. C goes second.
explain.rule: Each vehicle has another on its right. D turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody's path, so D goes first; then C, A, H.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is wrong: D goes first, C second.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: D goes first, C is second

q23130.en: At the junction in the picture vehicle A crosses the junction before vehicle C.

explain.short: C is on A's right, so A waits for C. A passes after C.
explain.rule: Each vehicle has another on its right. D turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody's path, so D goes first; then C, A, H.
explain.trap: 'prima del veicolo C' (before C) is wrong: C is on A's right.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: C is on A's right, so C goes first

q23131.en: At the junction in the picture the vehicles pass in this order: C, A, H, D.

explain.short: The right order is D, C, A, H. D goes first, not last.
explain.rule: Each vehicle has another on its right. D turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody's path, so D goes first; then C, A, H.
explain.trap: 'nel seguente ordine' (in this order): D is moved from first to last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: D goes first. Order: D, C, A, H

q23132.en: At the junction in the picture the vehicles pass in this order: H, A, C, D.

explain.short: This is the order backwards. The right order is D, C, A, H.
explain.rule: Each vehicle has another on its right. D turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody's path, so D goes first; then C, A, H.
explain.trap: 'nel seguente ordine' (in this order): it is the correct order reversed.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: reversed. Order: D, C, A, H

q23133.en: At the junction in the picture vehicles C and H pass first.

explain.short: C must wait for D and H must wait for A. Only D goes first.
explain.rule: Each vehicle has another on its right. D turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody's path, so D goes first; then C, A, H.
explain.trap: 'per primi' (first) is wrong: C is second and H is last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: only D goes first

q23134.en: When crossing the junction in the picture, vehicle L passes first.

explain.short: Nobody comes from L's right, so L goes first.
explain.rule: L has its right free and goes first. Then A and C go together (their paths do not cross). D is last: A and C are on its right.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is right: L's right is free.

sceneParams.caption: L has a free right: L goes first

q23135.en: When crossing the junction in the picture, vehicle D is the last to pass.

explain.short: A and C are on D's right, so D waits for them. D is last.
explain.rule: L has its right free and goes first. Then A and C go together (their paths do not cross). D is last: A and C are on its right.
explain.trap: 'l'ultimo' (the last) is right: D has A and C on its right.

sceneParams.caption: D is last: A and C are on its right

q23136.en: When crossing the junction in the picture, vehicles C and A pass at the same time after vehicle L.

explain.short: After L, A and C can go together: they come from the same road and their paths do not cross.
explain.rule: L has its right free and goes first. Then A and C go together (their paths do not cross). D is last: A and C are on its right.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time) is right here: A turns left, C goes straight, side by side.

sceneParams.caption: After L, A and C go together

q23137.en: When crossing the junction in the picture, vehicle A has priority over vehicle D.

explain.short: A comes from D's right, so D must give way to A.
explain.rule: L has its right free and goes first. Then A and C go together (their paths do not cross). D is last: A and C are on its right.
explain.trap: 'ha la precedenza' (has priority) is right: A is on D's right.

sceneParams.caption: A is on D's right: A goes first

q23138.en: When crossing the junction in the picture, the fastest vehicle passes first.

explain.short: Speed never decides who goes first. The right-of-way rules do.
explain.rule: L has its right free and goes first. Then A and C go together (their paths do not cross). D is last: A and C are on its right.
explain.trap: 'il veicolo più veloce' (the fastest vehicle) is the trap: speed gives no priority.

sceneParams.caption: Speed does not matter: L first by the rules

q23139.en: When crossing the junction in the picture, vehicle A passes last.

explain.short: A passes second, together with C, right after L. D is the last one.
explain.rule: L has its right free and goes first. Then A and C go together (their paths do not cross). D is last: A and C are on its right.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is wrong: D is last, not A.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: A goes with C; D is last

q23140.en: When crossing the junction in the picture, the vehicles pass in this order: C, A, D, L.

explain.short: L goes first, not last. The right order is L, then A and C together, then D.
explain.rule: L has its right free and goes first. Then A and C go together (their paths do not cross). D is last: A and C are on its right.
explain.trap: 'nel seguente ordine' (in this order): L is moved from first to last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: L goes first. Then A+C, then D

q23141.en: When crossing the junction in the picture, the vehicles pass in this order: C, L, A, D.

explain.short: C cannot go before L, because L is on C's right. The right order is L, then A and C together, then D.
explain.rule: L has its right free and goes first. Then A and C go together (their paths do not cross). D is last: A and C are on its right.
explain.trap: 'nel seguente ordine' (in this order): C is put before L, which is wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: L goes before C. Then A+C, then D

q23142.en: When crossing the junction in the picture, vehicles D and L pass at the same time before vehicle A.

explain.short: L goes first, but D is last: D must wait for A and C on its right.
explain.rule: L has its right free and goes first. Then A and C go together (their paths do not cross). D is last: A and C are on its right.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time) is wrong: D goes after A, not with L.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: L first, A+C next, D last

q23143.en: Arriving at the junction in the picture, the vehicles pass in this order: H, D, B, L.

explain.short: H turns right without crossing anyone and goes first; then D, B and L follow the right-hand rule.
explain.rule: H turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody, so it goes first. Then D (H was on its right), then B (D on its right), then L (B on its right).
explain.trap: 'nel seguente ordine' (in this order): H, D, B, L is exactly right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: H, D, B, L

q23144.en: Arriving at the junction in the picture, vehicle H passes first.

explain.short: H only turns right, close to the corner, and crosses nobody's path, so it goes first.
explain.rule: H turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody, so it goes first. Then D (H was on its right), then B (D on its right), then L (B on its right).
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is right: H's right turn blocks nobody.

sceneParams.caption: H turns right and goes first

q23145.en: Arriving at the junction in the picture, vehicle B passes before vehicle L.

explain.short: B is on L's right, so L gives way to B.
explain.rule: H turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody, so it goes first. Then D (H was on its right), then B (D on its right), then L (B on its right).
explain.trap: 'prima del veicolo L' (before L) is right: B is on L's right.

sceneParams.caption: B is on L's right: B goes before L

q23146.en: Arriving at the junction in the picture, vehicle D must give way to vehicle H.

explain.short: H comes from D's right, so D gives way to H.
explain.rule: H turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody, so it goes first. Then D (H was on its right), then B (D on its right), then L (B on its right).
explain.trap: 'deve dare la precedenza' (must give way) is right: H is on D's right.

sceneParams.caption: H is on D's right: D gives way

q23147.en: Arriving at the junction in the picture, vehicle L must give way to vehicle B.

explain.short: B comes from L's right, so L gives way to B.
explain.rule: H turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody, so it goes first. Then D (H was on its right), then B (D on its right), then L (B on its right).
explain.trap: 'deve dare la precedenza' (must give way) is right: B is on L's right.

sceneParams.caption: B is on L's right: L gives way

q23148.en: Arriving at the junction in the picture, vehicle L must pass last.

explain.short: L has B on its right, and B waits for D, who waits for H. So L is last.
explain.rule: H turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody, so it goes first. Then D (H was on its right), then B (D on its right), then L (B on its right).
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is right: L waits for all the others.

sceneParams.caption: L is last: B is on its right

q23149.en: Arriving at the junction in the picture, vehicle D passes before vehicle B.

explain.short: D is on B's right, so B gives way to D.
explain.rule: H turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody, so it goes first. Then D (H was on its right), then B (D on its right), then L (B on its right).
explain.trap: 'prima del veicolo B' (before B) is right: D is on B's right.

sceneParams.caption: D is on B's right: D goes before B

q23150.en: Arriving at the junction in the picture, vehicle B must wait for the other three vehicles to pass.

explain.short: B waits only for H and D. L is on B's left and waits for B.
explain.rule: H turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody, so it goes first. Then D (H was on its right), then B (D on its right), then L (B on its right).
explain.trap: 'degli altri tre' (the other three) is wrong: B goes before L.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: B waits for H and D, not for L

q23151.en: Arriving at the junction in the picture, vehicle H must wait until vehicles D and B have passed.

explain.short: H goes first. It is D and B who wait for H, not the opposite.
explain.rule: H turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody, so it goes first. Then D (H was on its right), then B (D on its right), then L (B on its right).
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait) is wrong: H is first.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: H goes first

q23152.en: Arriving at the junction in the picture, vehicles L and D pass at the same time.

explain.short: D goes second, L goes last. They do not pass together.
explain.rule: H turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody, so it goes first. Then D (H was on its right), then B (D on its right), then L (B on its right).
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time) is wrong: B passes between D and L.

sceneParams.caption: Not together: D second, L last

q23153.en: Arriving at the junction in the picture, the vehicles pass in this order: H, D, L, B.

explain.short: L cannot go before B, because B is on L's right. The right order is H, D, B, L.
explain.rule: H turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody, so it goes first. Then D (H was on its right), then B (D on its right), then L (B on its right).
explain.trap: 'nel seguente ordine' (in this order): the last two are swapped.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: B before L. Order: H, D, B, L

q23154.en: Arriving at the junction in the picture, vehicle B, since it turns left, has no right of way over any vehicle.

explain.short: Turning left does not remove B's right-hand priority: L is on B's left and must wait for B.
explain.rule: H turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody, so it goes first. Then D (H was on its right), then B (D on its right), then L (B on its right).
explain.trap: 'non ha diritto di precedenza su alcun veicolo' (no priority over any vehicle) is wrong: B has priority over L.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: B has priority over L

q23155.en: Arriving at the junction in the picture, vehicles L and D have priority because they do not turn.

explain.short: Going straight gives no priority. L is actually last, because B is on its right.
explain.rule: H turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody, so it goes first. Then D (H was on its right), then B (D on its right), then L (B on its right).
explain.trap: 'perché non effettuano svolte' (because they do not turn) is wrong: going straight is not a reason for priority.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: going straight gives no priority

q23156.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicle N passes after vehicle R.

explain.short: R is on N's right, so N gives way to R.
explain.rule: Deadlock: B has its right free but turns left. B moves to the centre and stops; then R passes, then D and N together, then B finishes.
explain.trap: 'dopo il veicolo R' (after R) is right: R is on N's right.

sceneParams.caption: R goes first, then D and N together

q23157.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicle B passes after vehicle N.

explain.short: B turns left, so it must let N (coming straight from the opposite side) pass first. B waits in the centre.
explain.rule: Deadlock: B has its right free but turns left. B moves to the centre and stops; then R passes, then D and N together, then B finishes.
explain.trap: 'dopo il veicolo N' (after N) is right: a left turn gives way to oncoming traffic.

sceneParams.caption: B waits in the centre; N passes before B

q23158.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicle D passes after vehicle R.

explain.short: R is on D's right, so D gives way to R.
explain.rule: Deadlock: B has its right free but turns left. B moves to the centre and stops; then R passes, then D and N together, then B finishes.
explain.trap: 'dopo il veicolo R' (after R) is right: R is on D's right.

sceneParams.caption: R goes first, then D and N together

q23159.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicle R passes after vehicle B has moved to the centre of the junction.

explain.short: B is on R's right. Once B has moved to the centre and stopped, it no longer blocks R, so R passes.
explain.rule: Deadlock: B has its right free but turns left. B moves to the centre and stops; then R passes, then D and N together, then B finishes.
explain.trap: 'dopo che il veicolo B si è spostato al centro' (after B has moved to the centre) is right: that is how the deadlock ends.

sceneParams.caption: B moves to the centre, then R passes

q23160.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicles D and N pass at the same time after vehicle R has passed.

explain.short: After R, D and N can go together: they come from the same road and their paths do not cross.
explain.rule: Deadlock: B has its right free but turns left. B moves to the centre and stops; then R passes, then D and N together, then B finishes.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time) is right here: D turns left, N goes straight, side by side.

sceneParams.caption: After R, D and N go together

keywords.it: dopo che è passato il veicolo R

q23161.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicle B, when entering the junction, must stop in the centre of it.

explain.short: B has its right free, so it enters first, but it turns left and must let N pass: so it stops in the centre.
explain.rule: Deadlock: B has its right free but turns left. B moves to the centre and stops; then R passes, then D and N together, then B finishes.
explain.trap: 'fermarsi al centro' (stop in the centre) is right: B enters, then waits there.

sceneParams.caption: B enters and stops in the centre

q23162.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicle R enters the junction and stops in the centre of it.

explain.short: It is B, not R, that stops in the centre. R goes straight across once B has moved.
explain.rule: Deadlock: B has its right free but turns left. B moves to the centre and stops; then R passes, then D and N together, then B finishes.
explain.trap: 'si ferma al centro' (stops in the centre) is wrong for R: it is B that does this.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: B stops in the centre, R goes straight

q23163.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicle N passes first.

explain.short: R is on N's right, so N must wait for R. N passes after R, together with D.
explain.rule: Deadlock: B has its right free but turns left. B moves to the centre and stops; then R passes, then D and N together, then B finishes.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is wrong: R passes before N.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: R passes first, then D and N

q23164.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicle D passes first.

explain.short: R is on D's right, so D must wait for R. D passes after R, together with N.
explain.rule: Deadlock: B has its right free but turns left. B moves to the centre and stops; then R passes, then D and N together, then B finishes.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is wrong: R passes before D.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: R passes first, then D and N

q23165.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicle D must give way to vehicle B.

explain.short: D and B come from opposite sides and both turn left: neither has to give way to the other.
explain.rule: Deadlock: B has its right free but turns left. B moves to the centre and stops; then R passes, then D and N together, then B finishes.
explain.trap: 'deve dare la precedenza' (must give way) is wrong: D and B do not give way to each other.

sceneParams.caption: D and B both turn left: no priority between them

q23166.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicle B must give way to vehicle D.

explain.short: B and D come from opposite sides and both turn left: neither has to give way to the other.
explain.rule: Deadlock: B has its right free but turns left. B moves to the centre and stops; then R passes, then D and N together, then B finishes.
explain.trap: 'deve dare la precedenza' (must give way) is wrong: B waits for N, not for D.

sceneParams.caption: B and D both turn left: no priority between them

q23167.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the picture vehicle R passes last.

explain.short: R passes right after B moves to the centre, before D and N. B finishes last.
explain.rule: Deadlock: B has its right free but turns left. B moves to the centre and stops; then R passes, then D and N together, then B finishes.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is wrong: R is the first to cross.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: R crosses first; B finishes last

q23168.en: At the junction in the picture the vehicles pass in this order: C, A, P.

explain.short: C has a free right and goes first; A had C on its right; P had A on its right.
explain.rule: Give way to the right. Nobody is on C's right: C first. C was on A's right: A second. A was on P's right: P last.
explain.trap: 'nel seguente ordine' (in this order): C, A, P is exactly right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: C, A, P

q23169.en: At the junction in the picture vehicle A passes after vehicle C.

explain.short: C is on A's right, so A gives way to C.
explain.rule: Give way to the right. Nobody is on C's right: C first. C was on A's right: A second. A was on P's right: P last.
explain.trap: 'dopo il veicolo C' (after C) is right: C is on A's right.

sceneParams.caption: C is on A's right: A goes after C

q23170.en: At the junction in the picture vehicle P passes last.

explain.short: P has A on its right, and A waits for C. So P is last.
explain.rule: Give way to the right. Nobody is on C's right: C first. C was on A's right: A second. A was on P's right: P last.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is right: P's right is not free.

sceneParams.caption: P is last: A is on its right

q23171.en: At the junction in the picture the vehicles pass in this order: P, C, A.

explain.short: P cannot go first: A is on its right. The right order is C, A, P.
explain.rule: Give way to the right. Nobody is on C's right: C first. C was on A's right: A second. A was on P's right: P last.
explain.trap: 'nel seguente ordine' (in this order): P is moved from last to first.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: P is last. Order: C, A, P

q23172.en: At the junction in the picture vehicle P passes before vehicle C.

explain.short: C goes first and P goes last. P does not pass before C.
explain.rule: Give way to the right. Nobody is on C's right: C first. C was on A's right: A second. A was on P's right: P last.
explain.trap: 'prima del veicolo C' (before C) is wrong: C is first, P is last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: C goes first, P last

q23173.en: At the junction in the picture vehicle P passes first because its right is free.

explain.short: P's right is not free: A is on its right. P goes last.
explain.rule: Give way to the right. Nobody is on C's right: C first. C was on A's right: A second. A was on P's right: P last.
explain.trap: 'ha la destra libera' (its right is free) is wrong: A is on P's right.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: A is on P's right. P is last

q23174.en: At the junction in the picture the vehicles pass in this order: S, N, C.

explain.short: S has a free right and goes first; N had S on its right; C had N on its right.
explain.rule: Give way to the right. S has its right free: first. N had S on its right: second. C had N on its right: last.
explain.trap: 'nel seguente ordine' (in this order): S, N, C is exactly right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: S, N, C

q23175.en: At the junction in the picture vehicle C goes through last.

explain.short: C has N on its right, and N waits for S. So C is last.
explain.rule: Give way to the right. S has its right free: first. N had S on its right: second. C had N on its right: last.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is right: N is on C's right.

sceneParams.caption: C is last: N is on its right

q23176.en: At the junction in the picture vehicle N goes through after vehicle S and before vehicle C.

explain.short: S is on N's right, so N waits for S. N is on C's right, so C waits for N.
explain.rule: Give way to the right. S has its right free: first. N had S on its right: second. C had N on its right: last.
explain.trap: 'dopo... e prima' (after... and before): both parts are right.

sceneParams.caption: N is second: after S, before C

q23177.en: At the junction in the picture the vehicles pass in this order: C, N, S.

explain.short: This is the order backwards. The right order is S, N, C.
explain.rule: Give way to the right. S has its right free: first. N had S on its right: second. C had N on its right: last.
explain.trap: 'nel seguente ordine' (in this order): it is the correct order reversed.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: reversed. Order: S, N, C

q23178.en: At the junction in the picture vehicle N goes through after vehicle C and after vehicle S.

explain.short: N goes after S, but before C: N is on C's right.
explain.rule: Give way to the right. S has its right free: first. N had S on its right: second. C had N on its right: last.
explain.trap: 'dopo il veicolo C' (after C) is the wrong part: C waits for N.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: N goes before C. Order: S, N, C

q23179.en: At the junction in the picture vehicle C goes through first.

explain.short: C has N on its right, so it must wait. C goes last.
explain.rule: Give way to the right. S has its right free: first. N had S on its right: second. C had N on its right: last.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is wrong: C is last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: C is last. Order: S, N, C
